digest.component_or_area: metrics blame module and ticket reference resolution
propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' diagnostics for bare 4-hex commit-subject fragments extracted from historical git log, blocking the CLI for minutes after the close has durably committed.

The enrichment drain was misattributed; the actual defect is in metrics/blame.py where _find_fixing_commit re-resolves the bug_id per commit against the entire ticket store without memoization or quiet mode, causing O(commits × tickets) alias scanning.

Four changes suppress the ambiguity noise and bound work: pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites, hoist bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoize ref resolutions within one derivation, and short-circuit hex-quad refs against the target's canonical id before filesystem access.

Documentation sweeps remove bare 4-digit hex references as a recommended form from _ids.py module docstring and AGENTS.md, retaining backward-compatible resolution while deprecating single-quad citations in favor of aliases, 8-digit two-quad prefixes, full ids, and Jira keys.

Regression tests verify no ambiguous-prefix output during caused-by derivation, bounded call counts per distinct ref rather than per commit, and that all previously-resolving id forms (full id, 8-hex prefix, alias, Jira key, unambiguous 4-hex) continue to resolve.
